text: 当地时间7月31日，美国财政部长贝森特在参加马里兰州戴维营举行的内阁会议期间表示，按照特朗普总统的指示，财政部持续对伊朗展开经济攻势，并且正在全球范围内追查伊朗资产。他还特意在特朗普面前罗列对伊朗的所谓“经济战果”：2025年3月推进相关行动后，当年年底伊朗最大民营银行宣告破产，伊朗央行被迫大量印钞，不断推高通胀，贝森特声称，如今伊朗甚至无力支付军饷。这番言论立刻引来网友质疑和吐槽。（央视）
text_en: On July 31 local time, U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said during a Cabinet meeting at Camp David in Maryland that, following President Trump's instructions, the Treasury continues its economic offensive against Iran and is tracking down Iranian assets worldwide. He even listed so-called "economic achievements" against Iran before Trump: after advancing related actions in March 2025, Iran's largest private bank went bankrupt by the end of that year, forcing the central bank to print money heavily and pushing inflation higher. Bessent claimed Iran is now unable to even pay military salaries. The remarks immediately drew skepticism and mockery from netizens. (CCTV)
